sections.heading: What data we collect
sections.body: When you sign in with Google, we receive your name, email address and profile picture. We also store the data you explicitly enter: companies, roles, links, notes and interview stages for your applications.

sections.heading: What we use it for
sections.body: We use this data exclusively to operate the service: showing your dashboard, computing your metrics and keeping your session active. We don't use it for advertising or sell it to third parties.

sections.heading: Who we share it with
sections.body: We use Google for authentication, and infrastructure providers (database and hosting) to run the application. These providers process data on our behalf and don't use it for their own purposes.

sections.heading: Cookies
sections.body: We only use technical cookies: one to keep you signed in, and one to remember your preferred language. We don't use advertising or third-party tracking cookies.

sections.heading: Your rights
sections.body: You can export all your data at any time from Settings, as JSON or CSV. You can permanently and immediately delete your account and all associated data, also from Settings.

sections.heading: Data retention
sections.body: We keep your data while your account is active. When you delete your account, all your data is permanently removed from our production databases.

sections.heading: Children
sections.body: This service is not directed at children under 16, and we don't knowingly collect data from children.

sections.heading: Changes to this policy
sections.body: If we make material changes to this policy, we'll note it on this same page along with the last updated date.

sections.heading: Contact
sections.body: For questions about your data or this policy, write to us at {contactEmail}.

sections.heading: Acceptance of terms
sections.body: By creating an account and using Job Tracker, you accept these terms. If you don't agree, please don't use the service.

sections.heading: Description of the service
sections.body: Job Tracker is a personal tool to log and organize your job applications. It's an early-stage product (MVP) and may change without prior notice.

sections.heading: Your account
sections.body: You're responsible for keeping access to your Google account secure. We don't share your account with third parties or use it for purposes other than what you authorize.

sections.heading: Acceptable use
sections.body: You may not use the service for illegal activities, attempt to access other users' data, or engage in scraping or automated abuse of the application.

sections.heading: Your content
sections.body: The data you enter (applications, notes, stages) is yours. We claim no ownership over that content; we only store it to provide the service to you.

sections.heading: Service availability
sections.body: Being an MVP, the service is provided "as is", without guarantees of continuous availability. We make a reasonable effort to keep it running, but we don't offer a guaranteed service level.

sections.heading: Limitation of liability
sections.body: To the extent permitted by law, we are not liable for indirect losses arising from use of the service, including data loss due to causes outside our reasonable control.

sections.heading: Account closure
sections.body: You can delete your account anytime from Settings. We may suspend accounts that violate these terms or that pose a risk to the service.

sections.heading: Changes to these terms
sections.body: We may update these terms as the product evolves. Material changes will be noted on this page.

sections.heading: Contact
sections.body: For any questions about these terms, write to us at {contactEmail}.
